headline_en: 10Y Yield Hits 5.1% as Tech Mixed; CRWD (UPTREND) +5.27%

Chip export bills and yield spike remain key risks for NVDA (UPTREND) and TSM (UPTREND)

market_mood.explanation_en: The regime score of 68.1 sits in constructive territory, like a boat moving forward with a moderate tailwind but choppy waves ahead. Investors can consider selective buys but should keep position sizes modest until the yield pressure eases.

big_picture.summary_en: The 10-year Treasury yield hit 5.1% for the first time in 19 years, driving equity declines through higher discount rates on growth names. Chip export legislation continues to advance, adding regulatory overhang to AI hardware supply chains.

big_picture.vix_note_en: VIX sits at 15.18, signaling calm and low fear in the market right now.

big_picture.rates_note_en: The 10-year yield at 5.11% is hurting growth stocks by raising borrowing costs and compressing valuations.

big_picture.dollar_note_en: The dollar index (DXY) is at 101.11, strengthening and pressuring tech and global earnings through translation effects.
